description: This PHP class `EntityTransformer` in the Goteo project provides methods for transforming model entities into different representations, including generating URLs, accessing properties, and retrieving linked media.

classes.name: EntityTransformer
classes.description: An abstract class for transforming model entities, providing utility methods for accessing model data and related assets.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the transformer with a model and optional keys.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific raw values from the model based on a key.

methods.name: getApiProperty
methods.description: Constructs an API URL to modify a property of the model.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the model.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name or title of the model.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Gets the image link associated with the model.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Gets the icon link associated with the model.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the model.

methods.name: getSubTitle
methods.description: Returns the subtitle of the model.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of the model.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Provides a URL for editing the model if the user is available.

methods.name: getLangs
methods.description: Returns available languages for the model.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Checks if the model is active.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order value of the model.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city associated with the model.
